1.w: And it came to pass after the plague that YHWH spoke to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, saying,

2.w: “Take a census of all the congregation of the sons of Israel, from a son of twenty years and above, by the house of their fathers—all who are able to go to war in Israel.”

3.w: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan [near] Jericho, saying,

4.w: “From a son of twenty years and above, as YHWH has commanded Moses.” And the sons of Israel who came out of the land of Egypt:

5.w: Reuben [was] the firstborn of Israel. The sons of Reuben: Of Hanoch, the clan of the Hanochite; of Pallu, the clan of the Palluite;

6.w: of Hezron, the clan of the Hezronite; of Carmi, the clan of the Carmite.

7.w: These [are] the clans of the Reubenite, and those numbered were three and forty thousand and seven hundred and thirty.

8.w: And the sons of Pallu: Eliab,

9.w: and the sons of Eliab [were] Nemuel and Dathan and Abiram. [They] are the Dathan and Abiram, called of the congregation, who contended against Moses and Aaron in the company of Korah when they contended against YHWH.

10.w: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, and with [them] Korah in the death of the company, when the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men, and they became a sign.

11.w: And the sons of Korah did not die.

12.w: The sons of Simeon by their clans: Of Nemuel, the clan of the Nemuelite; of Jamin, the clan of the Jaminite; of Jachin, the clan of the Jachinite;

13.w: of Zerah, the clan of the Zerahite; of Shaul, the clan of the Shaulite.

14.w: These [are] the clans of the Simeonite, two and twenty thousand and two hundred.

15.w: The sons of Gad by their clans: Of Zephon, the clan of the Zephonite; of Haggi, the clan of the Haggite; of Shuni, the clan of the Shunite;

16.w: of Ozni, the clan of the Oznite; of Eri the clan of the Erite;

17.w: of Arod, the clan of the Arodite; of Areli the clan of the Arelite.

18.w: These [are] the clans of the sons of Gad by their numbered ones, forty thousand and five hundred.

19.w: The sons of Judah [were] Er and Onan, and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

20.w: And the sons of Judah by their clans were: Of Shelah, the clan of the Shelanite; of Perez, the clan of the Perezite; of Zerah, the clan of the Zerahite.

21.w: And the sons of Perez were: Of Hezron, the clan of the Hezronite; of Hamul, the clan of the Hamulite.

22.w: These [were] the clans of Judah by their numbered one, six and seventy thousand and five hundred.

23.w: The sons of Issachar by their clans: Of Tola, the clan of the Tolaite; of Puvah, the clan of the Punite;

24.w: of Jashub the clan, of the Jashubite; of Shimron, the clan of the Shimronite.

25.w: These [were] the clans of Issachar by their numbered ones, four and sixty thousand and three hundred.

26.w: The sons of Zebulun by their clans: Of Sered, the clan of the Seredite; of Elon, the clan of the Elonite; of Jahleel, the clan of the Jahleelite.

27.w: These [were] the clans of the Zebulunite by their numbered, sixty thousand and five hundred.

28.w: The sons of Joseph by their clans: Manasseh and Ephraim.

29.w: The sons of Manasseh: Of Machir, the clan of the Machirite; and Machir begat Gilead; of Gilead, the clan of the Gileadite.

30.w: These [were] the sons of Gilead: Of Iezer, the clan of the Iezerite; of Helek, the clan of the Helekite;

31.w: and of Asriel, the clan of the Asrielite; and of Shechem, the clan of the Shechemite;

32.w: and of Shemida, the clan of the Shemidaite; and of Hepher, the clan of the Hepherite.

33.w: And Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons, but only daughters. And the names of the daughters of Zelophehad [were] Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

34.w: These [were] the clans of Manasseh, and their numbered [ones were] two and fifty thousand and seven hundred.

35.w: These [were] the sons of Ephraim by their clans: Of Shuthelah, the clan of the Shuthalhite; of Becher, the clan of the Bachrite; of Tahan, the clan of the Tahanite.

36.w: And these [were] the sons of Shuthelah: Of Eran, the clan of the Eranite.

37.w: These [were] the clans of the sons of Ephraim by their numbered ones, two and thirty thousand and five hundred. These [were] the sons of Joseph by their clans.

38.w: The sons of Benjamin by their clans: Of Bela, the clan of the Belaite; of Ashbel, the clan of the Ashbelite; of Ahiram, the clan of the Ahiramite;

39.w: of Shupham, the clan of the Shuphamite; of Hupham, the clan of the Huphamite.

40.w: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: [Of Ard], the clan of the Ardite; of Naaman, the clan of the Naamite.

41.w: These [are] the sons of Benjamin by their clans, and their numbered [ones were] five and forty thousand and six hundred.

42.w: These [were] the sons of Dan by their clans: Of Shuham, the clan of the Shuhamite. These [were] the clans of Dan by their clans.

43.w: All the clans of the Shuhamite by their numbered [ones were] four and sixty thousand and four hundred.

44.w: The sons of Asher by their clans: Of Imnah, the clan of the Imnite; of Ishvi, the clan of the Ishvite; of Beriah, the clan of the Beriite.

45.w: Of the sons of Beriah: Of Heber, the clan of the Heberite; of Malchiel, the clan of the Malchielite.

46.w: And the name of the daughter of Asher [was] Serah.

47.w: These [were] the clans of the sons of Asher by their numbered ones, three and fifty thousand and four hundred.

48.w: The sons of Naphtali by their clans: Of Jahzeel, the clan of the Jahzeelite; of Guni, the clan of the Gunite,

49.w: of Jezer, the clan of the Jezerite; of Shillem, the clan of the Shillemite.

50.w: These [were] the clans of Naphtali by their clans; and their numbered [ones were] five and forty thousand and four hundred.

51.w: These [were] numbered ones of the sons of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.

52.w: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

53.w: “To these land shall be divided as an inheritance by the number of names.

54.w: To the many you shall increase their inheritance, and to the few you shall diminish their inheritance; each according to their numbered shall be given its inheritance.

55.w: But by lot the land shall be divided; by the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

56.w: According to mouth, the lot of their inheritance shall be divided between many and few.”

57.w: And these [are] the numbered ones of the Levite by their clans: Of Gershon, the clan of the Gershonite; of Kohath, the clan of the Kohathite; of Merari, the clan of the Merarite.

58.w: These [are] the clans of Levi: The clan of the Libnite, the clan of the Hebronite, the clan of the Mahlite, the clan of the Mushite, and the clan of the Korahite. And Kohath begat Amram.

59.w: And the name of the wife of Amram [was] Jochebed daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. And she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses and Miriam their sister.

60.w: And were born to Aaron Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

61.w: And Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the face of YHWH.

62.w: And their numbered ones were three and twenty thousand, every male from a son of a month and above; for they were not numbered in the midst of the sons of Israel, because no inheritance was given to them in the midst of the sons of Israel.

63.w: These [were] numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the sons of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan [opposite] Jericho.

64.w: And among these there was not a man of those numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest when they numbered the sons of Israel in the Wilderness of Sinai.

65.w: For YHWH had said of them: They will surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
